reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: Investment in EUR-denominated green bond issue in an amount of EUR 30 million as part of a total aggregate issuance of EUR 300 million by Lietuvos Energija UAB ("LE UAB"), the Lithuanian's national energy company and one of the largest state-owned energy groups in the Baltics. The investment programme which the EBRD is supporting is critical to help LE UAB to upgrade its distribution network and expand its renewable energy capacity in order to strengthen the sustainability and security of Lithuania's energy supply and reduce its reliance on imported energy. The issue will also enhance LE UAB capital structure by centralising indebtedness at the holding level.
